setup.text: An astronomer imagines distant people placing crafted objects high above the clouds.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A navigator wonders whether such objects could study weather and oceans.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A stargazer asks how one would distinguish a crafted light from a celestial body.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The researchers speculate about signals carried over great distances.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child asks who would repair a device no one can reach.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A naturalist worries about falling debris and crowded skies.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A philosopher asks whether claiming the heavens changes humanity's responsibilities below.
